checks.evidence: PBD hız kısıtlamasının ilk hesaplanması, step 1: OBU computes and activates the PBD speed restriction from received PBD data. Reference also expects permitted speed equal to V1 within the restriction, which is only partly covered.

invented: Computed speed is the highest speed satisfying the inequalities of SUBSET-026 §3.11.11.6 and rounded down to a multiple of 5 km/h
Example values PBD=1000 m, emergency brake, gradient 0%, and a change from 1000 m to 800 m
Recomputed speed is lower than or equal to the old value when PBD is shorter
